4	
5	Clientloop is the codename (from Phase 18 dossier candidates) for the ManyRequests-style SaaS already researched across 22 phases in the Boldteq dossier (`ManyRequestsDossier.jsx`). 7	Yash is **intentionally overriding** the gate for a narrow purpose: build the **UI shell only** (mock data, no backend, no auth wiring) so it can be **used as the clickable validation asset** Phase 15 already requires (Figma-alternative prototype for LOI interviews). This is the cheapest path to satisfy the gate without wasting build effort later — the shell becomes real production code once the gate passes.
8	
9	**What we are building in Phase 1:**
10	- Agency-side UI shell for Clientloop
11	- Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript (strict, no `any`) + Tailwind + shadcn/ui
12	- Three working screens: Dashboard Home, Request Inbox (table + Kanban toggle), Clients/Services/Settings

18	- No Clerk, Neon, Prisma, Razorpay, Stripe, Claude API, tRPC

20	- No client-facing portal (agency side only)
21	- No landing page / marketing site (separate Quill work later)
22
